title: I made a directory of 300+ browser games built with AI.
author: TheRealXmo
selftext:
[Foundplay.io](http://Foundplay.io) lists 300+ AI-made browser games, from Vibe Jam entries to one-off experiments. It doesn't host anything: every listing links to the creator's own site.

- Every game is tagged phone-friendly or keyboard, and phones see touch games first.
- The most played games have guides: controls, what you need and our take.
- Creators can claim a listing by putting a code on their page or posting it from their X account.

[https://foundplay.io](https://foundplay.io)

Which games am I missing?

comments.author: Dignified_Cyclops
comments.body:
\> Creators can claim a listing by putting a code on their page or posting it from their X account.

What if creators don't want there game on your site? Your privacy policy doesn't mention it?

replies.author: TheRealXmo
replies.body: They can send me an email and I'll quickly take it down, no questions asked!

comments.author: -Unpaid_Wizard-
comments.body: Why do we need ANOTHER one of these sites. You think you may have an original idea but you dont. You are now 1 of 10,000 other sites that does the EXACT same thing. yawn

replies.author: TheRealXmo
replies.body: Can you share the other sites? I actually wasn't able to find one like this which is why I made it

replies.author: TheRealXmo
replies.body: Some great ones out there. I'll check them out and see what I can learn to improve foundplay!

replies.author: NZDarkFalcon
replies.body: This is the top google result dude, so thanks for being no help at all.

comments.author: howdensity
comments.body: tagging phone-friendly vs keyboard and sorting touch games first for phones seems like the detail that decides whether i'd actually browse this on my couch

replies.author: TheRealXmo
replies.body: sweet, thanks for the feedback! i agree. did the sort function work for you OK?
